output_bulk_cap.description: 1000µF ±20% 25V Through Hole,D10xL16mm Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors - Leaded ROHS
output_bulk_cap.role: Bulk output capacitance for 12V rail, minimize output voltage ripple
output_bulk_cap.notes: Low ESR radial electrolytic for bulk energy storage. Will use 2x in parallel for 2000µF total.

output_hf_filter_cap.description: 47µF ±20% 25V X5R 1206 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
output_hf_filter_cap.role: High-frequency filtering, parallel with electrolytics to reduce ESR at switching frequency
output_hf_filter_cap.notes: Will use 4-6x in parallel for ~200-300µF total HF capacitance. X5R/X7R for stable capacitance.
